source_hash_note: Hashes are SHA-256 of the committed Git blob content (LF); Windows materializes CRLF but the blob identity stays this value.

contract.source: experiments/shell/shell.cpp history_wheel: SPI_GETWHEELSCROLLLINES per wheel event; initialized 3; WHEEL_PAGESCROLL -> max(1, height-1)
contract.query: SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETWHEELSCROLLLINES) on each wheel detent; not cached
contract.positive: that many physical history rows per whole detent
contract.page: WHEEL_PAGESCROLL (DWORD(-1)) -> current visible height - 1, at least 1
contract.query_failure: 3 lines, matching the R1 pre-query initialization; never guessed as page mode
contract.other_platforms: QStyleHints positive line count only; 0 disables; no unverified page marker
contract.setting_updates: re-read on the next wheel event, so normal users observe later system changes

test.fixture: src/qt/history_fixture.hpp (unchanged from the merged history slice)
test.injection: recoverable app-internal WheelSettingForTest; host global setting is never modified
test.native_check: read-only SPI value compared with the observed native wheel step

visual_evidence.reason: Only the wheel step source changes; history pages and screenshots remain the merged history slice's offscreen states.

limitations: Windows 11 x64 offscreen Qt 6.10.3 only; host global wheel setting is read, never modified.
Page step is the R1 product contract (visible height minus one, at least one), not a new WindTerm runtime oracle.
No scrollbar drag, PageUp/PageDown history mapping, paste-return, selection/copy/Find during reading, physical presentation/DPI, Unicode history or performance.
The query-failure fallback is exercised through the recoverable diagnostic injection; the native failure branch itself was not induced by changing host policy.
#317 native-grid vs retained-source decision remains separate; old six-stage --resize exit 1 is preserved. #27/#29/#30/#7 remain open.
